book.name: Mataio
book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Hahu Muiḡa Hari Idaidaḡa
Iesuꞌa hari idaidaḡa nu hina bare ḡoreziro,
“Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌetaꞌaꞌe kini ꞌahoga heuḡa. Aniꞌa ubuga veize hahu muiḡa haḡairo.
Ebu huziroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa mui aroga veize tuḡure azaḡa zeḡe vaḡe tuḡuziro. Rehano zeꞌe aroga hezahiro.

Ebu aniꞌa tuḡure azaḡa ꞌahoga nu bare tuḡuzeꞌenaꞌa, ziro, 'Eḡeꞌa huzateꞌe azaḡaꞌe ꞌahige rae zoꞌi: Eḡeꞌa zae veize mui ruhibeha. Boromakau zu mani iga manadu ogomu niduꞌa ꞌai ruhibeha. Hahu muiḡa uꞌa aroꞌi.'
Rehano ze teḡa riraro ebu zeḡe edeḡano onamiro. ꞌAhogaꞌe mebaḡa onamiro ebu ꞌahogaꞌe hadi vaḡi onamiro.
Ebu nuꞌe tuḡure azaḡa oboze teadu sausauziro ebu zimi ruziro.
Kiniꞌa eꞌe igirotene, ani maḡune rudaro. Ebu ani uti azaḡa tuḡuzadu gorugoru azaḡa eꞌe zimi hauḡiro zu neze zuni hufi haoniro.
Ebu ane tuḡure azaḡa huzadu ziro, 'E hahu muiḡa ꞌai ruhibe idaneha, rehano eḡeꞌa huziroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe arogaꞌe mene idaḡa.
Eꞌanoꞌo ibi boroboro onamadu horoziteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa mui aroga veize huzoꞌi.'
Ebu ane tuḡure azaḡaniꞌa ibi boroboro onamadu hidiroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa, manoḡa zu sauꞌa azaḡa niduꞌa nuꞌoziro ebu zamaze onamadu huziroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa mui neḡa iri'avoniro.
Ebu kiniꞌa iꞌudo azaḡa ḡiazihi radu diuḡirotene, vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa hahu mui dabuaḡa mene vidaroteꞌe horoniro.
ꞌOugadu aneꞌa ḡadiniro, ꞌEḡe nabudi, ḡaꞌe hahu dabuaḡa mene vidaneha. Nougenouge ꞌadi diuḡi areha?' Rehano ani ḡoere ꞌahoga mene reiro.
ꞌOugadu kiniꞌa ane gau azaḡa ziro, 'Ani ꞌevoꞌa zu odaḡa batunadu enone uzaboḡano feune bunoꞌi. Ane eꞌea niaꞌuma zu ḡononeḡa atitiꞌuma.'”
Ḡonagano Iesuꞌa ziro, “Badiꞌaꞌa huziroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ḡehaḡa, rehano ohotiroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe tahiḡa daꞌo.”
Takesi Hadiḡa Iniu Haꞌuma?
Eꞌe madaḡano Farisea azaḡaniꞌa onamadu, “Iesuꞌa ḡoere veꞌoḡa ꞌahoga reine obone tiꞌuma,” rae ḡoꞌaniro.

Ebu zeꞌa zeḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa zu kini Heroda mone azaḡaꞌe Iesu mazao tuḡuzadu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, emeꞌe edeḡa, ḡaꞌe huga daꞌo ḡoereꞌohe zu Badiꞌa mone ibiḡa hugano ihozeꞌohe ebu vaze niduꞌa mazao mene inaheꞌenaꞌa, vaze uꞌano zamaḡo mene haganeꞌohe.
Eꞌanoꞌo ḡaꞌe nouge rae zamareꞌohe? Emeꞌe Roma kiniḡa mazao takesi haune, duduḡa ga mene?”
Iesuꞌe zeḡe zamarone sauꞌa ederadu ziro, “Zaꞌe zama guhi azaḡa, nougadu eḡe tuhuheꞌohe?
Takesi hadiḡa ihohoꞌi.” Ze Roma hadiḡa
tiba mae harotene,
aneꞌa ḡadiziro, “Iniu viga zu iniu niḡaꞌe eꞌe rana mirihiro?”
Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Aꞌe Roma kiniḡa viga zu niḡa.” Ebu aneꞌa ziro, “Tena Roma kiniḡa ḡauꞌe Roma kiniḡa hanoꞌi, u Badiꞌa ḡauꞌe Badiꞌa hanoꞌi.”
Ze ani ḡoere igirotene zaguzagaro ebu ani muhinadu oname ḡouriro.
Runeonoꞌo Bare Ḡabodeꞌeteꞌe Ḡadimuḡa
Eꞌe madaḡano Sadukea azaḡa nuꞌa Iesu vaḡe ariro. Sadukea azaḡaꞌe vazeꞌa runeonoꞌo mene bare ḡabodiꞌuma rae reiro. Zeḡeꞌa Iesu ḡadiniro,

“Ihore vazeḡa, Moseꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa ꞌahoga ꞌahige rae mirihiro, 'Ohoze ꞌahoganiꞌa rudanadu ani inugaꞌe ubuga ꞌoꞌoꞌa reine, ohoze negoḡaniꞌa ḡozobaḡa teite hahuriꞌuma, ebu ubuga furenadu ubuganiꞌa rune negoḡa ehaꞌa meꞌuma.'
Tena hari ꞌahi zamaroꞌi. Negoḡa niduꞌa fuꞌo aheu fareꞌa radiunu. Ibiꞌaniꞌa hahuriro ebu ubuga oꞌoꞌa rudaro. ꞌOugadu negoḡa aheuḡaniꞌa ḡozobaḡa teite hahuriro.
Rehano ane zuni ubuga oꞌoꞌa rudaro, ebu negoḡa uḡiduḡa onamo fuꞌo aheu fare mazao ꞌuguḡaniꞌa idane fureraro.
Ḡonagano ḡozoba eꞌe zuni rudaro.
Tena runeonoꞌo bare ḡaboditeꞌe madaḡano roḡae aꞌe iniu inuga reꞌuma? Mazaḡa ohoze niduꞌa fuꞌo aheu fareꞌa ani teite hahuriro.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Zaꞌa zamareꞌetaꞌaꞌe veꞌoḡa, mazaḡa zaꞌe Buka Zaḡoḡa ga Badiꞌa gigiꞌaḡa moneo aḡuꞌa.
Runeonoꞌo bare ḡaboditeꞌe madaḡanoꞌe ohoze zu roḡaeꞌe mene hahuriꞌuma. Zeꞌe tuḡure viga adureo teigiꞌuma.
Rune azaḡaniꞌa bare ḡabodeꞌeteꞌe moneo, Badiꞌaꞌa reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa zaeꞌa mene meꞌodirohe? Aneꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro,
'Eꞌe Aberahamo Badiꞌa, Isako Badiꞌa zu Iakobo Badiꞌa.' Badiꞌaꞌe mene rune azaḡa Badiꞌa, rehano ḡabone azaḡa Badiꞌa.”
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa Iesu ihoreḡa ḡoeꞌa igirotene, zaguzagaro.
Goro Ḡoeꞌa Ḡihiꞌa Hune
Ebu Farisea azaḡaniꞌa Iesuꞌa Sadukea azaḡa ḡadimu naenaenadu hebeze ꞌuiroteꞌe hariḡa igirotene, tibano nuꞌoraro.
Ebu zeḡe boꞌaḡano Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu tuhune nurihi radu ḡadiniro,
“Ihore vazeḡa, Mose goro ḡoeꞌa niduꞌa zamaḡano noꞌe goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Goro ḡoeꞌa ḡihiꞌa huneꞌe ꞌahi eꞌe: 'Zuhiꞌa Boro ḡae Badiꞌa zamaḡo niduꞌa hina, vineḡo niduꞌa hina zu zamaroneḡo niduꞌa hina zamare borofoꞌi.'
Aꞌe goro ḡoeꞌa ibiꞌa zu ḡihiꞌa hune.
Goro ḡoeꞌa ḡihiꞌa hune aheuḡa zuni eꞌe heuḡa: 'Ḡa ḡae bare zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe teige, nabugo zuni zamare borofoꞌi.'
Mose goro ḡoeꞌa niduꞌa ebu peroveta azaḡaniꞌa ihoziroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa niduꞌaꞌe goro ḡoeꞌa aheu eꞌe rana ohoniro.”
Kerisoꞌe Iniu Mariga?
Farisea azaḡaniꞌa nuꞌoraroteꞌe zamaḡano Iesuꞌa ḡadiziro,
“Zaꞌe Keriso moneo nouge rae zamareꞌohe? Aniꞌe iniu mariga?” Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Aniꞌe Davida mariga.”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Tena nougadu Davidaꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa ihonadu Keriso mazao Zuhiꞌa Boro rae huniro? Aniꞌe ꞌahige rae reiro,

content.text: “Eḡe edaꞌe moneo ehoroꞌi, onamo eḡeꞌa agireḡo niduꞌa madu odaḡo ꞌuꞌuḡano raharahaziꞌuma.”'

content: Davidaꞌa Keriso mazao Zuhiꞌa Boro rae huniro. Tena Kerisoꞌe nougenouge Davida mariga reꞌuma?”
Ebu vazeni ꞌahoga zuni Iesu mene naenaeniro. Eꞌe enogano vazeni ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu mene bare ḡadiniro.
